original_feed.formula: f_c,m = m * c / (2 W_m), W_m = W_lu * a; TE0 cutoff-free

narrowed_feed.formula: f_c,m = m * c / (2 W_m), W_m = W_lu * a; TE0 cutoff-free

target.rationale: Place TE1 cutoff at 6.5 GHz so TE1 is evanescent over Band B (≤5.25 GHz) and Band C (≤5.5 GHz) with margin.
